speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing dizziness, nausea, and imbalance; to understand the cause, can you describe exactly where you feel dizzy, such as if the room is spinning or if you feel like you might faint?

speaker: Patient
text: 27-year-old male. The patient reports a sustained sensation of the room spinning since this morning, which is low grade and constant. speaker: Doctor
